sourceReview.reason: Rechecked the complete AMBCrypto roundup dated Nov 11 (https://ambcrypto.com/spacex-on-chain-blackrock-on-solana-ondo-builds-the-tails-tokenizations-breakout-year/). RWA Signal explicitly attributes its Nov 12 summary to AMBCrypto, so it is not independent reporting. The article's time-sensitive $337.8bn market capitalization, 15,304 assets, 62% outside-hours trading and $423m SHVon figures cite Token Terminal, a social post and RWA.xyz without a directly checked dated primary data snapshot. Other Ondo BlackRock portfolio launches in the available independent reports occurred in September/October, not a new Nov 12 launch. No new single event supported by a primary source or two independent full reports. Retain held; retry no earlier than six hours after reviewedAt.
